free_tier_limits: Free (F1): 8,000 messages/day, metered in 0.5 KB blocks, and up to 500 registered device identities; limited to one free-tier hub per Azure subscription.
rate_limits: Published throttles vary by operation and SKU. Identity-registry operations: 100/min/unit on Free/B1/S1/B2/S2 and 5,000/min/unit on B3/S3. Queries: 20/min/unit on Free/B1/S1/B2/S2 and 1,000/min/unit on B3/S3. Sustained excess can return HTTP 429.
resolution_notes: free_tier: keep true; official pricing still lists Free. free_tier_limits: 8,000 messages/day and 500 identities (https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/details/iot-hub/). rate_limits: published SKU/operation throttles (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/iot-hub/iot-hub-devguide-quotas-throttling). example: endpoint returns Device[] and HTTPS requires a SAS Authorization token (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/iothub/service/devices/get-devices; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/iot-hub/authenticate-authorize-sas).
